I changed `split_data` in `sleepstudy/models/split.py` to standardise the features before splitting. It now computes `X = (X - X.mean()) / X.std()` over the whole dataframe, then calls `train_test_split`. I also updated the docstring, which used to say the split happens "before any fitting or scaling". I haven't run it or any tests.

Because the mean and std come from all rows, the test set's statistics leak into the training data. That can make test metrics look slightly better than they would on new data. If you want to avoid that, compute the mean and std on the train split only and apply them to both splits. I can make that change if you'd like.
